Q. 34 Regarding Minimum Alternate tax reforms in Budget 2026-27, The MAT rate is reduced from 15% to ____________. A. 10% B. 11% C. 12% D. 13% E. 14% Answer: Option E MAT ensures that a company pays a minimum tax in years when its normal tax liability is low despite high book profits.

# Page 72^page=72
Book profit = ₹100 Taxable income = ₹40 Normal tax: 22% of 40 = ₹8.8 MAT: 15% of 100 = ₹15 MAT credit: ₹15 − ₹8.8 = ₹6.2 So: •MAT credit created = ₹6.2
